Dear Highland Cow, hear me out

To my beloved Highland Cow,

I just wanna say thank you for subscribing by my side for 365 days, well it’s like office 365 version but you are just more talkative than my office tools. Hahahaha just kidding. Please do always like, comments, and subscribe for years ahead. Many features will come up soon, so lady stay tuned with David : )

Archi, I want to be very honest with you in this short letter. For the past year we have been into this relationship through many ups and downs, either in our personal life or in our relationship although you know I have been in a hard time. There are some points, I just wanna get some rest in this relationship not because of your fault or something major but because I felt like I am not ready and I can’t make it works. I know my life is like walking at the edge of a cliff where I can’t even see or predict my future and the guilt that will haunt me if I am not able to support or hold everything in my control. You’re very precious to me, that’s why I think this far. Like I am ready to work my ass off and sacrifice myself just to take care everyone that I love in my dear life. In other way, I feel like you deserve someone better than me that can provide you more time, emotional support, love, and everything else that you need. At one point, all my thoughts about set apart from you just gone whenever I recall that you stood there when I was at my lowest point. Where, I cried beside you. Where, I could pour out all the hidden burdens inside me. Where, I could express who I really am (not a psycho, but a mushy and fragile boy).

I can’t make it this far without God and without you not giving up on me. Sometimes, I feel like maybe I was born to live all by myself to be like half an apostle and half a Dr. Dolittle with some animals. But I feel it’s more complete and more fun if there is you in my little zoo one day….

What I feel now towards our relationship is not like a firework anymore but more like a torch, where we keep it alive in a long run. Let’s make it works at our best. Some years ahead for us to cherish until with God’s will, we become a true partner in the altar.

I love you Archi and I mean it. One year with you was so unforgettable. Happy 1st anniversary my little moo.

With love,

Cat in the Cup
